sources.covers: 894 cm-1 EC Raman band and its +11 cm-1 shift on Li+ binding (DFT plus comparison with experiment)

notes: EC is solid at RT (mp ~34-37 °C). Positions here are from liquid EC (melt) or EC in carbonate electrolytes, not the crystal; crystalline EC differs, especially in the C=O region. Sources disagree by ±3 cm-1 (893-897 for ring breathing; 1773-1781/1800-1808 for the C=O doublet). Diagnostic: 893 (free) vs 903 (Li+-bound) ring breathing and 717-720 vs 729-733 ring deformation. No intensities given in the sources; ring breathing ~893 is the strongest band in the fingerprint region. C-H stretch positions are from SERS and may be slightly shifted from normal Raman.

sources.covers: +11 cm-1 DFT shift of the 894 band on Li+ binding, consistent with experiment; Raman activity of coordinated EC ~17-20% higher than free

notes: Solution species, not an isolated compound: appears alongside free EC in any Li-salt/EC electrolyte. Solvation numbers are obtained by fitting the 893/903 pair (or 717/730); Borodin et al. recommend correcting for the ~17-20% higher Raman activity of coordinated EC. Positions vary by a few cm-1 with salt, concentration and co-solvent. Laser listed is that of the main source (Miele); RSC Adv source used 532 nm.

sources.ref: Åvall G., Wallenstein J., Cheng G. et al., Highly Concentrated Electrolytes: Electrochemical and Physicochemical Characteristics of LiPF6 in Propylene Carbonate Solutions, J. Electrochem. Soc. 2021, 168, 050521 (open access)
sources.covers: 712 (free PC) Raman ring mode, 848 and 958 Raman reference bands (FT-Raman, 1064 nm); IR bands 774, 1043, 1074, 1173, 1353, 1388, 1779 also tabulated (IR, not Raman)

notes: Neat liquid at RT. Only the Raman bands explicitly given in the source are listed; the paper's Table II gives FTIR positions for PC (C=O 1779, CO2 asym 1173, ring 1353/1388, C-O 1043, ring/C-Me 1074, ring deformation 774/711) which have Raman counterparts nearby but are not Raman values. Commercial PC is racemic with ring-puckering conformers, which complicates band fitting (Allen et al. 2014). Incomplete band list: C=O (~1780-1790) and C-H region not confirmed from an opened Raman source.
